name: VoDaSuRe
description: Recent advances in volumetric super-resolution (SR) have demonstrated strong performance in medical and scientific imaging, with transformer- and CNN-based approaches achieving impressive results even at extreme scaling factors. In this work, we show that much of this performance stems from training on downsampled data rather than real low-resolution scans. This reliance on downsampling is partly driven by the scarcity of paired high- and low-resolution 3D datasets. To address this, we introduce VoDaSuRe, a large-scale volumetric dataset containing paired high- and low-resolution scans.
